description: Test file for image input pixel guard functions using the Vitest testing framework. It contains unit tests verifying image size constraints, error handling, and environment configurations related to image processing.

methods.name: getImageMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata from an image buffer, returns null if image exceeds pixel limit.

methods.name: resizeToJpeg
methods.description: Resizes an image buffer to JPEG with specified constraints, rejects if image is too large or pixel count overflows.

methods.name: createPngBufferWithDimensions
methods.description: Creates a PNG buffer of specified dimensions for testing purposes.

calls: expect(resizeToJpeg({ buffer: oversizedPng, maxSide: 2048, quality: 80 })).rejects.toThrow(/pixel input limit/i)
expect(resizeToJpeg({ buffer: overflowedPng, maxSide: 2048, quality: 80 })).rejects.toThrow(/pixel input limit/i)
expect(await resizeToJpeg({ buffer: Buffer.from('not-an-image'), maxSide: 2048, quality: 80 })).rejects.toThrow(/unable to determine image dimensions/i)
